description: Map a run's distinct failure signatures to docs.jmeter.ai error playbooks. Error text is sent to classifier.dev for zero-shot classification (public keyless calls are not stored; obvious secrets are redacted first). Prefer signatures shaped as "sampler | response code | response message".

classifierApiKey.description: Your own classifier.dev API key (anonymous quota is shared); never logged.

count.description: How many samples showed this signature (default: 1).

text.description: One distinct failure signature, ideally "sampler | response code | response message".

minConfidence.description: Confidence threshold for auto-bucketing a signature to a playbook (default: 0.7).

tier.description: Classifier tier (default: "fast"). "smart" re-asks only signatures below minConfidence (slower).

name: triage_errors
title: Triage a Batch of JMeter Error Signatures
